string-array.name: help_lines
string-array.item: Entry: tap the round button on the IME settings page to open this screen.
Config is per host, stored in files/haostoo/config/state.json and applied immediately.
Four modes: off, system preset, simple custom (duration + strength), custom waveform.
Custom waveform supports 2–8 segments: first duration fixed to 0, each 0–500 ms, amplitude 0–255, at least one above 0 ms.
The curve is a preview only; vibration follows the discrete values.
Tap the title area to view the other host; unreadable data shows a hint only.
